warrants.quote: A total of 8,680,000 PIPE Warrants remain outstanding as of September 30, 2022.
On June 21, 2022, the Company issued warrants to purchase 1,000,000 shares of Common Stock to certain sellers in connection with the acquisition of Alpha-5 Integrin, LLC

an aggregate of 1,000,000 warrants to purchase shares of the Company’s Common Stock at an exercise price of $1.88 per share, which may be exercised on a cashless basis, for a period of five years commencing on the date of issuance
